title: PanelValue Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for PanelValue objects, covering access through a component's panel member, Panel Execute DAT usage, basic members, validity, and implicit numeric/string casting.
guidance: Use this article when scripting panel state through a component's panel member or when handling Panel Execute DAT callbacks.
Use name to identify which panel value is referenced and owner to reach the OP that owns the value.
Use val when explicit get/set readability matters, but plain PanelValue use in parameter or numeric expressions can get or set the value without explicit eval() or set().
Check valid before relying on a stored PanelValue reference; it becomes false when the referenced panel value has been deleted.
Use the Panel Value article for the complete list of available panel value names and their per-panel semantics.
